factcheck.claim: Semantic Scholar is fully free (200M+ papers), ResearchRabbit free, both discovery-only
Elicit: free tier + paid from ~$12/mo, higher Pro tier ~$49/mo, 138M+ paper index, structured extraction
Perplexity Pro $20/mo ($200/yr), deep research 2-4 min; lowest citation failure but still 37% in Columbia Tow Center audit
All AI research tools still fabricate citations; database-grounded tools hallucinate less (ratios ~0.05-0.42) than open-web chatbots
NotebookLM free tier generous (100 notebooks, 50 sources each), synthesis of your own sources, no discovery
ChatGPT Deep Research $20/mo Plus, 5-30 min, longest/most structured, asks clarifying questions
